decisions.reason: The lighting clause from message 189 is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event, including its cool, fun, inviting DJ-style purpose.
The same-message INTRODUCE Event already captures the requested DJ-style knobs, measurement units around the bowls, and small visual details.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that captures the request to use text and logos from the CAD renderings; the source identity change entails no additional branding-state change.
Message 189 requests color as part of the visual treatment but does not replace or otherwise change the existing beige-and-green color decisions.
The visual-character decision does not change the required mixing result, texture, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The references to visual details around the bowls do not change bowl capacity, bowl form, or the accepted bowl-size reference.
Emphasizing the machine's cool DJ appearance does not necessarily alter the current V1 priority or the established custom-spout sourcing policy.
The source visual decision does not change whisk size, style, material, attachment, compatibility, or operating depth.
Message 189 does not modify the spout's location, orientation, construction, geometry, or beverage-quality constraints.
Using the CAD renderings as a visual reference does not change the system-layout or CAD deliverable state.
The visual identity modification has no necessary effect on the finalized wiring-plan deliverable.
The mention of knobs and visual details concerns styling and does not change the dispensing mechanism, flow behavior, operation sequence, or button interaction.
